Frequently Asked Questions

Authoritative answers on sovereign UAE infrastructure, direct OEM hardware lead times, SIRA/MCC compliance, ERPNext licensing, and enterprise support SLAs.

We engineer Tier-III and Tier-IV compliant data centre infrastructure utilizing factory-direct OEM hardware from Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, Cisco, HPE, and NVIDIA. Standard rack architectures and flash storage clusters are dispatched with guaranteed UAE regional lead times of 10 to 14 business days.

All enterprise deployments include guaranteed 4-hour on-site mission-critical hardware replacement SLAs across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the northern emirates, backed by 24/7 onshore certified escalation engineers.

Yes, end-to-end. QWT is fully licensed and certified with both the Security Industry Regulatory Agency (SIRA) in Dubai and the Monitoring & Control Center (MCC) in Abu Dhabi. We manage the entire lifecycle: initial engineering drawings, site surveys, camera coverage lux calculations, and regulatory submission.

We deploy approved Milestone XProtect and Genetec VMS platforms configured for 31-day tamper-proof RAID-6 video archival, watermarked frame authentication, biometric access control, and guarantee 100% first-pass official inspection sign-off.

All security telemetry, SIEM event logs, and AI model inference remain strictly within sovereign UAE geographical boundaries. We design air-gapped on-premise compute enclaves, hardware unidirectional data diodes, and Zero-Trust microsegmentation that prevent cross-border data exfiltration.

Our 24/7 Managed SOC operates onshore from Dubai Silicon Oasis aligned with NESA Information Assurance standards, providing automated EDR threat containment through CrowdStrike Falcon Complete and Palo Alto Networks clusters with a guaranteed <15-minute triage SLA.

Legacy ERP platforms (like SAP S/4HANA or Microsoft Dynamics) bill recurring monthly per-seat licensing fees that scale aggressively as your workforce grows. In contrast, ERPNext is 100% open-source with zero recurring user license fees — whether you have 25 or 5,000 active employees.

QWT delivers turnkey enterprise implementations fully localized for the UAE: automated Federal Tax Authority (FTA) 5% VAT filings, reverse-charge tax accounting, Ministry of Human Resources (MOHRE) Wages Protection System (WPS) .SIF file generators, UAE labor law end-of-service gratuity calculations, and native bilingual Arabic/English interfaces.

QWT NFC smart business cards share your comprehensive contact dossier, bio, company portfolio, and social links with a single contactless tap to any iPhone or Android device — with zero app installation required.

Contacts can directly download your pass into Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, receiving automatic push notifications whenever your phone, title, or office address changes. Organizations also gain a centralized enterprise admin portal to provision, manage, update, or revoke thousands of employee credentials simultaneously, with real-time tap analytics and direct two-way CRM sync (Salesforce, HubSpot, ERPNext).

We are registered on official government procurement networks, including Tejari, Dubai Government eSupply, and Abu Dhabi ERP platforms. We accommodate official Government Purchase Orders (PO), ADGM / DIFC corporate invoicing, letter of credit (LC), and milestone-based deliverables.

Enterprises can acquire turnkey systems via capital expenditure (CAPEX) or flexible operational leasing (OPEX / Infrastructure-as-a-Service) bundled with multi-year OEM warranty coverage and 24/7 Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
